message.content:
I need the COMPLETE current constituent list of the SPDR S&P Biotech ETF (ticker XBI). Today is 2026-06-21.

Try to fetch these URLs (use WebFetch, or the firecrawl skill/firecrawl-scrape if available) and extract the full holdings table:
- https://stockanalysis.com/etf/xbi/holdings/
- https://www.barchart.com/etfs-funds/quotes/XBI/constituents
- https://www.alphalerts.com/etf/XBI/constituents
- https://www.ssga.com/us/en/intermediary/etfs/state-street-spdr-sp-biotech-etf-xbi

For EVERY holding return: ticker, company name, weight %. Note the "as of" date on the page and total holding count.

If you cannot get the full table, get as many rows as you can and PRIORITIZE the smaller/lower-weight holdings (bottom of the list by weight) — those are the clinical-stage names I care about most. Be explicit about how complete your list is and which URL/date it came from. Return the raw list, do not editorialize.

- firecrawl: Search, scrape, and interact with the web via the Firecrawl CLI. Use this skill whenever the user wants to search the web, find articles, research a topic, look something up online, scrape a webpage, grab content from a URL, get data from a website, crawl documentation, download a site, or interact with pages that need clicks or logins. Also use when they say "fetch this page", "pull the content from", "get the page at https://", or reference external websites. This provides real-time web search with full page content and interact capabilities — beyond what Claude can do natively with built-in tools. Use this skill when the user wants structured data from websites, needs to extract pricing tiers, product listings, directory entries, or any data as JSON with a schema.
